card.description:
SCOPE RULED 2026-10-04 (operator via Helios): card 12 is shrunk to dotfiles card 171's disposition for this repo (~/dotfiles/specs/136-*/tasks.md, 'Vendored-copy dispositions (FR-013)'). Copying the card-aware allocator in, and the interim forwarder, are both moot: ~/bin/speckit is the host-global entry point and the pi prompts call `speckit create-new-feature`, never a repo-local copy.

DONE ON THIS BRANCH. The three stale scripts are deleted; the stale create-new-feature.sh allocated by local scan and ran `git checkout -b`. .specify/feature.json is untracked and ignored, because tracked it pointed every checkout at specs/1401. Verified: `speckit create-new-feature --json --dry-run --short-name probe probe` from this worktree returns FEATURE_NUM 1402 and leaves the branch on card-12; `git grep -nE 'create-new-feature\.sh|setup-plan\.sh|check-prerequisites\.sh' -- ':!specs/' ':!cards/'` finds no caller. specNumber 1402 went unused: the change needed no spec.

No tracked caller of the deleted scripts outside specs/ and cards/. specNumber 1402 unused; no spec dir was needed.
